⏺ The retry wrapper treats a 429 as retryable. When the provider says
  "You've hit your limit" the client should back off until the reset time,
  and a "usage limit" error must not be retried in a tight loop. I updated
  the rate limit handler and added a test where the server returns 429 Too
  Many Requests twice before succeeding.

⏺ Update(internal/client/retry.go)
  ⎿  Updated internal/client/retry.go with 12 additions
